senses.gloss: Saudāsa (“the son of Sudāsa”) = Kalmāshapāda (Mitrasaha): I, 4736, 6774; III, 13817; XII, 1792 (dāyādaḥ Sºsya… Sarvakarmā); XIII, 326 (Kośalādhipaḥ), 3732 (Ikshvākuvaṃśajo rājā), 3734; XIV, 1654, 1656 (purushādaṃ), (1672), (1674), (1679), 1681, (1691), (1694), (1700), (1704).
Saudeva (“the son of Sudeva”) = Divodāsa: XIII, 1954 (Dº), 1967.
Saudyumni (“the son of Sudyumna”) = Yuvanāśva: III, 10432, 10435.
